QuestInfo.0: Since Erion upheld his end of the deal, the time's come to release him. However, Neinheart calls and says further discussion will be required...
QuestInfo.1: Erion speaks about how he doesn't want to leave the prison after all, and Neinheart allows him to stay, on the condition that he keep making weapons for the Alliance.
QuestInfo.2: Erion was officially appointed as an Alliance weapon master, which suited Erion just fine.
